title: Building Intelligent Applications with Spring AI
subtitle: Develop Practical Java Solutions with Generative AI, Multimodal Models, and Agents
description: Teaches Spring developers to build chat, audio, image, and agent features with Spring AI, and to test and observe them.

title: Generative AI-Driven Application Development with Java
subtitle: Leveraging Large Language Models in Modern Java Applications
description: A project-based book that goes from a first LLM call to RAG, agents, and AI microservices on the JVM with Spring Boot or Quarkus.

title: Applied AI for Enterprise Java Development
subtitle: Leveraging Generative AI, LLMs, and Machine Learning in the Java Enterprise
description: Shows enterprise Java developers how to add generative AI, LLMs, and machine learning to Java systems, with patterns for prompts, RAG, and production use.

title: Spring AI in Action
description: Shows Spring Boot developers how to add generative AI features with Spring AI, including prompts, RAG, chat memory, tool calling, and MCP.

title: Beginning Spring AI
subtitle: A Quick Guide to AI Engineering in Spring
description: A short introduction that gets Spring developers calling AI models from Spring AI for text, images, and audio.

title: Understanding LangChain4j
subtitle: 2nd Edition
description: A self-published guide to the LangChain4j library, from calling an LLM to embeddings, RAG, and testing.

title: Mastering Spring AI
subtitle: The Java Developer's Guide for Large Language Models and Generative AI
description: Covers adding LLM features to Spring Boot applications with Spring AI, including prompts, RAG, and function calling.

title: Deep Learning for Search
description: Shows how to use neural networks with Apache Lucene and Deeplearning4j to improve search.

title: Machine Learning in Java
subtitle: Helpful Techniques to Design, Build, and Deploy Powerful Machine Learning Applications in Java, 2nd Edition
description: Covers the machine learning workflow in Java, from preparing data to classification, clustering, and recommendations.

title: Deep Learning
subtitle: A Practitioner's Approach
description: Explains how deep learning works and how to build and train neural networks on the JVM with Deeplearning4j.
